tests.title: format v1.8 flash fixtures: flash.timing, flash.log, flash.ecc, slot.corrupt, ch394.silent
format v1.8: flash.fault, watchdog reset of a never-ending erase, RCC_RSR, power.cut replaced, AXI SRAM at power-on
flash.log entries end at a reset and a pause; an erase clears ECC marks; net.endpoint whole; net.log order; CYCCNT against the timers over masked erases

note: In one emulator, in this order: the sequence that killed the emulator with the flash layer of 5960f2a (2 of 2 runs, tb_phys_invalidate): an ECC watchpoint installed inside a store of the core, the marked word read in the same translated block. The layer after it installs watchpoints only from a timer event.
